checks.name: local-paths
checks.run: if git grep -nE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])/(home|tmp)/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+'; then echo 'a machine-local path is in tracked text'; exit 1; fi

checks.name: agent-docs
checks.run: scripts/sync-agent-docs.sh --check && scripts/sync-agent-docs.sh --check . && head -c "$(wc -c < templates/AGENTS.md)" AGENTS.md | cmp - templates/AGENTS.md

checks.name: bash-n
checks.run: set -eu; for file in bin/* lib/*.sh templates/*.sh scripts/*.sh scripts/dev/*.sh tests/*.sh tests/fixture/*.sh; do bash -n "$file"; done; echo 'bash -n: every script parses'

checks.name: json
checks.run: python3 -I -c 'import glob, json; files = sorted(glob.glob("*.json") + glob.glob("templates/*.json") + glob.glob("examples/*.json") + glob.glob("tests/fixture/*.json")); [json.load(open(f, encoding="utf-8")) for f in files]; print("parsed %d JSON documents" % len(files))'

checks.name: shellcheck
checks.run: shellcheck -x -P ".:SCRIPTDIR" bin/* lib/*.sh templates/*.sh scripts/*.sh scripts/dev/*.sh tests/*.sh tests/fixture/*.sh && echo 'shellcheck: clean'
